init.title: Tado X Options
init.description:
Configure your Tado X integration settings.

**API Quota:**
- Without Auto-Assist: 100 requests/day → updates every 45 min
- With Auto-Assist: 20,000 requests/day → updates every 30 sec

data_description.has_auto_assist: Enable this if you have an Auto-Assist subscription. This will automatically adjust the update interval.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the Tado API (in seconds). Minimum: 30s, Maximum: 3600s (1 hour). Without Auto-Assist, keep at 2700s (45 min) to stay under 100 requests/day.
data_description.enable_weather: Enables outdoor temperature, solar intensity, and weather state sensors. Uses 1 API call per update.
data_description.enable_mobile_devices: Enables device trackers for mobile phones with geofencing. Uses 1 API call per update.
data_description.enable_air_comfort: Enables air freshness and comfort level sensors per room. Uses 1 API call per update.
data_description.enable_running_times: Enables heating time today sensors per room. Uses 1 API call per update.
data_description.enable_flow_temp: Enables max flow temperature slider and auto-adaptation switch (requires OpenTherm boiler). Uses 1 API call per update.
data_description.enable_hot_water: Enables domestic hot water state sensor. Uses 1 API call per update.
data_description.enable_schedule_polling: Checks Home and Away schedules. Uses 2 API calls per room per update. Enabled by default with Auto-Assist; disabled by default without it.
data_description.schedule_poll_interval: How often to check schedules when enabled. Minimum: 900 seconds (15 minutes); default: 3600 seconds (1 hour); maximum: 86400 seconds (24 hours).

set_temperature_offset.name: Set temperature offset
set_temperature_offset.description: Adjust the temperature offset for a Tado X device (valve or sensor). This calibrates the device's temperature reading.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The Tado X device to calibrate

offset.name: Temperature offset
offset.description: Temperature offset in °C. Positive values make the device read higher, negative values make it read lower.

add_meter_reading.name: Add meter reading
add_meter_reading.description: Upload a meter reading to Tado Energy IQ

device_id.name: Tado X Home device
device_id.description: Optional when only one Tado X home is configured; select the Tado X Home device when multiple homes are configured (not a room or thermostat).

date.name: Date
date.description: Date of reading (YYYY-MM-DD format, defaults to today)

set_eiq_tariff.name: Set energy tariff
set_eiq_tariff.description: Set an energy tariff in Tado Energy IQ for cost calculations

device_id.name: Tado X Home device
device_id.description: Optional when only one Tado X home is configured; select the Tado X Home device when multiple homes are configured (not a room or thermostat).

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: Start date for the tariff (YYYY-MM-DD format, defaults to today)

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: End date for the tariff (YYYY-MM-DD format, leave empty for ongoing tariff)

set_climate_timer.name: Set climate timer
set_climate_timer.description: Set a room temperature override. Timer (default) requires temperature and duration; Manual requires temperature only; Next time block requires temperature but not duration.

entity_id.name: Climate entity
entity_id.description: The Tado X climate entity (room) to control

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Required for Timer, Manual and Next time block.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Required only for Timer (1-1440 minutes); ignored for Manual and Next time block.

termination_type.name: Termination type
termination_type.description: Timer (default if omitted) requires temperature and duration; Manual requires temperature only; Next time block requires temperature only.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Read the current smart heating schedule for a room. Returns the schedule blocks as a response.

entity_id.name: Climate entity
entity_id.description: The Tado X room to query or control

get_away_schedule.name: Get away schedule
get_away_schedule.description: Read the stored per-room Away mode, temperature and preheating configuration. Returns the settings as a response without changing them.

entity_id.name: Climate entity
entity_id.description: The Tado X room whose Away settings should be returned

set_away_schedule.name: Set away schedule
set_away_schedule.description: Update a room's Tado X Away mode, temperature and optional preheating level. Existing saved schedule profiles are not modified. When enabling Away from OFF, specify a temperature.

entity_id.name: Climate entity
entity_id.description: The Tado X room whose Away configuration should be updated

mode.name: Away mode
mode.description: Enable or disable Away temperature control

away_temperature.name: Away temperature
away_temperature.description: Temperature in °C when Away mode is ON. If omitted, the current Away temperature is retained when available. Ignored for OFF.

preheating_level.name: Preheating level
preheating_level.description: Optional Tado X preheating setting; if omitted, the current setting is preserved.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Modify the smart heating schedule for a room. Replaces the blocks for the given day type.

entity_id.name: Climate entity
entity_id.description: The Tado X room to query or control

day_type.name: Day type
day_type.description: Which day(s) this schedule applies to.

schedule.name: Schedule blocks
schedule.description: JSON array of schedule blocks. Each block: {"dayType": "MONDAY", "start": "07:00", "end": "09:00", "setting": {"power": "ON", "temperature": {"value": 21.0}}}. "power" is ON or OFF; "temperature" may be null when power is OFF.

get_day_report.name: Get day report
get_day_report.description: Read historical temperature, humidity and heating data for a room and date. Returns the report and a summary as a response. Today's data works on all tiers; past days require an Auto-Assist (Premium) subscription.

entity_id.name: Climate entity
entity_id.description: The Tado X room to query or control

date.name: Date
date.description: Date to fetch (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

get_holiday_mode.name: Get holiday mode
get_holiday_mode.description: Read the home's holiday mode settings (enabled, start/end dates and room settings). Returns the settings as a response. Requires an Auto-Assist (Premium) subscription.

device_id.name: Tado X Home device
device_id.description: Optional when only one Tado X home is configured; select the Tado X Home device when multiple homes are configured (not a room or thermostat).

set_holiday_mode.name: Set holiday mode
set_holiday_mode.description: Enable or disable holiday mode and optionally set its start/end date. Requires an Auto-Assist (Premium) subscription. Dates are ISO-8601 date-time strings.

device_id.name: Tado X Home device
device_id.description: Optional when only one Tado X home is configured; select the Tado X Home device when multiple homes are configured (not a room or thermostat).

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn holiday mode on (true) or off (false).

save_schedule_profile.name: Save schedule profile
save_schedule_profile.description: Save the current Home and Away schedule to a room profile, or to a home-wide template using a name such as Eco default.

restore_schedule_profile.name: Restore schedule profile
restore_schedule_profile.description: Restore a room profile (with home default fallback), or explicitly restore a home-wide template using a name such as Eco default.

list_schedule_profiles.name: List schedule profiles
list_schedule_profiles.description: List configured and unconfigured schedule profiles for a room.

delete_schedule_profile.name: Delete schedule profile
delete_schedule_profile.description: Delete a user-defined schedule profile. Default profile names cannot be deleted.

reset_schedule_default.name: Reset home schedule default
reset_schedule_default.description: Remove a customized home-wide template, reverting to the factory schedule. Does not change any room's active schedule or saved room profiles.

device_id.name: Tado X Home device
device_id.description: Optional when only one Tado X home is configured; select the Tado X Home device when multiple homes are configured.

profile.name: Default profile name
profile.description: Normal, Alternative, Eco, or Not in use (optional default suffix).
